events.name: UNIT_CLICK
events.description: Unit-click event. The neutral drawable host cannot resolve a click to a per-entity id (descriptors carry only a `ScenePos`, no id), so this prop is accepted but not yet emitted — the id-hit-test is a tracked fork (docs/Almadar_Std_Game_V2_PLAN.md).

events.name: TILE_HOVER
events.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.

events.name: TILE_LEAVE
events.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Background Image
overridableConfigKeys.description: Background image (tiled behind iso/hex/flat/free; cover-scaled for atlas slices). A bare URL string is accepted as shorthand for a standalone backdrop.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bg Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Solid backdrop colour (drawn when no `backgroundImage`).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Camera
overridableConfigKeys.description: --- View config (pure render) ---

overridableConfigKeys.label: Camera Pos
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial camera position in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.pos`). The host projects this to screen space and centers the viewport on it for the first render; ignored once the user pans or a follow target takes over.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Children
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). When `drawables` is empty, each child registers its descriptor via the drawable registry context and the host paints them.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: --- Closed-circuit ---

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drawables
overridableConfigKeys.description: --- Scene ---

overridableConfigKeys.label: Error
overridableConfigKeys.description: Error state

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fit
overridableConfigKeys.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (default false — boards render at their authored `scale` and overflow → pan). Opt in for whole-board-overview boards. User wheel/pinch zoom always wins after the initial fit.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Follow Target
overridableConfigKeys.description: Follow-camera target in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.target`). When `camera:'follow'` the host lerps to keep this point centered.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Is Loading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Loading state indicator

overridableConfigKeys.label: Key Map
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Key Up Map
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Projection
overridableConfigKeys.description: --- Projection ---

overridableConfigKeys.label: Scale
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render scale, legacy-squared semantics: on-screen cell ≈ `256 × scale²` px (the authored contract every board tuned its value for). Converted internally to the single camera zoom against the board's native tile width, so the cell pitch follows the asset while the on-screen size stays as authored. Ignored when `fit` is on; passed through raw for `free`/`side` (world-pixel-direct).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show Minimap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Toggle minimap overlay.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: --- Declarative events back to LOLO ---

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Hover Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Leave Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Native tile/cell width in source px for this board's asset (e.g. 16 for Kenney tiny-dungeon, ~128 for iso blocks). The grid cell pitch follows the asset, so tile textures map 1:1 (crisp, no stretch). Defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Unit Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Unit-click event. The neutral drawable host cannot resolve a click to a per-entity id (descriptors carry only a `ScenePos`, no id), so this prop is accepted but not yet emitted — the id-hit-test is a tracked fork (docs/Almadar_Std_Game_V2_PLAN.md).
